title: QA-CAL-04 Calibration Entry
summary: Ledgerline screen QA-CAL-04 maintains instrument calibration and renewal dates across Manchester and Leeds plants using services cal_save, cal_get, and cal_due.
body:
Screen QA-CAL-04 is accessed from the Production > Calibration menu and maintains gauge calibration records across both the Manchester and Leeds plants [^r1]. It allows authorised users to retrieve calibration history, record completed internal checks, and view upcoming or overdue tool verifications [^r3][^r5][^r6][^r7]. Access is available to roles PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, and SYS-ADMIN [^r10].

## Fields

| Field | Label | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gauge_no` | GAUGE NO | Yes | Equipment or tool identifier [^r2][^r6][^r11]. |
| `cal_dt` | CAL DT | Yes | Date the physical calibration test was completed or last passed [^r2][^r3][^r7][^r11]. |
| `due_dt` | DUE DT | Yes | Next verification or calculated expiry point date [^r2][^r3][^r7][^r11]. |

To record an internal instrument check, the user opens QA-CAL-04, keys the equipment identifier into GAUGE NO, and invokes `cal_get` to populate registration details and inspection history [^r6]. The user enters the physical test completion date in CAL DT and the next verification date in DUE DT before committing the update via `cal_save` [^r7].

## Keys and services

Screen QA-CAL-04 operates three backend services from the [[services-prd-cal|PRD cal services]] group [^r11][^r12]:

* `cal_get` (F3): Retrieves the live gauge record by `gauge_no`, populating registration details, inspection history, CAL DT with the date last passed, and DUE DT with the calculated expiry point [^r3][^r6][^r11][^r14].
* `cal_save` (F8): Write service that commits updated calibration records (`gauge_no`, `cal_dt`, and `due_dt`) to central quality tables [^r4][^r7][^r11][^r12][^r15].
* `cal_due`: Read service invoked at endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/cal_due` with mandatory field `gauge_no` to query calibration due details, generating a list of instruments with approaching or overdue renewal dates on active lines across the works [^r5][^r9][^r11][^r13].

## Messages

* [[err-cal-0001|ERR-CAL-0001]]: Raised on the status line when the tool identifier entered in GAUGE NO cannot be found during retrieval [^r8][^r11].

## See also

* [[err-cal-0001|ERR-CAL-0001 Calibration Tool Not Found]]
* [[services-prd-cal|PRD cal services]]
* [[screen-qa-ins-01|QA-INS-01 Incoming Inspection Entry]]
* [[screen-qa-ncr-02|QA-NCR-02 Non-Conformance Report Entry]]
* [[screen-qa-btt-03|QA-BTT-03 Battery End-Of-Line Test Entry]]

r1.quote: Screen QA-CAL-04, menu Production > Calibration. Services: cal_save, cal_get, cal_due.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: gauge_no GAUGE NO Yes cal_dt CAL DT Yes due_dt DUE DT Yes

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Ledgerline fills the CAL DT field with the date on which the tool was last passed, and it fills the DUE DT field with the expiry point previously calculated

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Press the cal_save button to call the CALIBRATION SAVE service. Ledgerline ERP validates the entries, posts the new dates to the central quality tables

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Click the cal_due button to call the CALIBRATION DUE service. Ledgerline ERP scans the register for all instruments assigned to active assembly lines where the scheduled renewal date is approaching or already passed.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Click the button for the service cal_get (CALIBRATION GET). Ledgerline retrieves the current registration details for that instrument

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: Confirm all entries on screen QA-CAL-04 match the signed paper calibration slip returned from the test bench.

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: If the tool cannot be found under the entered reference, the system returns ERR-CAL-0001 on the status line

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r9.quote: This generates the current list of gauges across the works that have reached or passed their required check date.

r10.quote: Menu: Production > Calibration. Roles: [PRD-PLAN, PRD-SUP, QA-INSP, QA-MGR, SYS-ADMIN].

r11.quote: GAUGE NO gauge_no str Yes CAL DT cal_dt date Yes DUE DT due_dt date Yes

r12.quote: Kind: write. Screen: QA-CAL-04. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_cal_save.

r13.quote: service: cal_due title: CALIBRATION DUE module: PRD kind: read screen: QA-CAL-04

kind: read
screen: QA-CAL-04
